links.effect: GPT-4 76.2% vs CoT-GPT 86.1%; Claude 3.5 83.2% vs CoT-Claude 87.1%

links.comparator_used: Original off-the-shelf GPT-4 and Claude 3.5 without customization
links.outcome: Accuracy on multiple-choice questions, and QUEST ratings (accuracy, readability, comprehensiveness, likelihood of harm, reasoning) on short-answer and case questions
links.effect: Multiple-choice accuracy: TED-GPT 86.1% vs GPT-4 76.2%; TED-Claude 89.1% vs Claude 3.5 83.2%. Customized models also performed better on case and short-answer questions, with TED-Claude best overall.
links.quote: For case and short-answer questions, the customized TED-GPT and TED-Claude also performed better than their original versions.

design_hint: domain-specific customization and Chain-of-Thought prompting of existing LLMs
